mapper.select: SELECT -- 헤더 컬럼 sh.schedule_header_id, c.contract_no, sh.payment_stage, sh.schedule_regime, sh.schedule_purpose, sh.schedule_version_no, sh.status AS header_status, sh.active_yn, COUNT(sl.schedule_line_id) OVER (PARTITION BY sh.schedule_header_id) AS line_count, COALESCE(SUM(sl.expected_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sh.schedule_header_id),0) AS expected_total, CONCAT(pv.policy_code,' v',pv.version_no) AS policy_version_label, -- 라인 컬럼 sl.line_no, sl.installment_no, sl.contract_month_no, sl.due_date, ci.item_name AS commission_item_name, a.agent_name AS recipient_name, sl.basis_code, sl.basis_amount, sl.calculation_type, sl.rate_pct, sl.expected_amount, sl.line_status -- 필요한 JOIN 컬럼들 FROM schedule_header sh JOIN insurance_contract c ON c.contract_id = sh.contract_id JOIN policy_version pv ON pv.policy_version_id = sh.policy_version_id LEFT JOIN schedule_line sl ON sl.schedule_header_id = sh.schedule_header_id LEFT JOIN agent a ON a.agent_id = sl.beneficiary_agent_id LEFT JOIN commission_item ci ON ci.commission_item_id = sl.commission_item_id WHERE sh.schedule_header_id = #{scheduleHeaderId} ORDER BY sl.line_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fgc.schedule_header ( contract_id, payment_stage, policy_version_id, schedule_version_no, schedule_purpose, scenario_code, schedule_regime, status, active_yn, generation_reason, regenerated_from_id ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{paymentStage}, #{policyVersionId}, #{scheduleVersionNo}, #{schedulePurpose}, #{scenarioCode}, #{scheduleRegime}, #{status}, #{activeYn}, #{generationReason}, #{regeneratedFromId} )

INSERT INTO fgc.schedule_line ( schedule_header_id, line_no, installment_no, contract_month_no, due_date, commission_item_id, beneficiary_agent_id, basis_code, basis_amount, calculation_type, rate_pct, fixed_amount, expected_amount, rounding_scale, rounding_mode, payment_condition_code, line_status, source_commission_rule_id ) VALUES
( #{line.scheduleHeaderId}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.installmentNo}, #{line.contractMonthNo}, #{line.dueDate}, #{line.commissionItemId}, #{line.beneficiaryAgentId}, #{line.basisCode}, #{line.basisAmount}, #{line.calculationType}, #{line.ratePct}, #{line.fixedAmount}, #{line.expectedAmount}, #{line.roundingScale}, #{line.roundingMode}, #{line.paymentConditionCode}, #{line.lineStatus}, #{line.sourceCommissionRuleId} )
